basic_info.description: Located on Bernal Heights' desirable North slope, this meticulously maintained, semi detached 2-BDR 1920's home has it all! Connected kitchen, dining, & living spaces. Large, sunny kitchen with stainless appliances opening to a bright garden. A light filled living room w/ decorative fireplace and views to downtown. A spacious formal dining room. A huge garage, with ample parking & storage. Warm wood floors, period dets & a tiled full BA complete the package. On corner lot on a quiet tree-lined St, this home is a short walk to Bernal Hill, & to Precita Park & Mission neighborhood retail hubs. Close to BART,  tech shuttles, & 101/280 freeways. Why settle for a condo when you can have a great home in an A+ location?
